item.title: WONDER MAN Trailer Sees Simon Williams Targeted By The Department Of Damage Control (And Superhero Fatigue)
item.description: Marvel Television is beginning 2026 in style, releasing a new trailer and poster for Wonder Man, confirming that the superpowered Simon Williams will be targeted by the Department of Damage Control.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Concept Art Reveals Character Designs For Unmade 2015 Live-Action Movie
item.description: Concept artist Constantine Sekeris has shared some of his designs for the live-action Masters of the Universe movie that was in development back in 2015 before the plug was pulled...

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASHES Passes $250 Million At Domestic Box Office; Will Reach $1 Billion Worldwide In Days
item.description: Avatar: Fire and Ash managed to reach $250 million at the North American box office on New Year's Eve, and $1 billion worldwide is looming. What of the Stranger Things finale, though?

item.title: Disney Reflects On A Banner Year At The Box Office In 2025, Hitting A Milestone Not Seen Since 2019
item.description: While overall numbers at the box office were down in 2025, it was a solid year for Disney, who eclipsed $6 billion in movie ticket sales.

item.title: VIKINGS: VALHALLA Star Frida Gustavsson Confirms Interest In Playing The DCU's Wonder Woman
item.description: With rumours swirling about DC Studios casting Wonder Woman for Man of Tomorrow, The Witcher actress Frida Gustavsson has confirmed that she would be interested in playing Diana Prince.

item.title: Let It Go, Elsa! ZOOTOPIA 2 Shatters Records As Walt Disney Animation’s Highest-Grossing Film Ever
item.description: The Zootopia 2 stampede at the box office continues racing past the $1.46B mark, dethroning Frozen 2 in the process. The question now: can it overtake Pixar’s Inside Out 2?

item.title: 2026 Rewinds The Clock To The Era Of THE BIG THREE As NARUTO, BLEACH And ONE PIECE Are Set To Own The New Year
item.description: For the first time since 2012, the original Naruto anime, One Piece, and Bleach are all slated to release new anime episodes in 2026, recreating the historic movement of the era-defining “Big Three.”

item.title: SCREAM 7: Ghostface Shares A Chilling New Year's Message With Sidney Prescott In New Teaser
item.description: Paramount Pictures has marked the first day of 2026 with a brief new teaser for Scream 7, which finds Ghostface sharing a list of sinister New Year's resolutions...

item.title: Byeon Woo-seok’s SOLO LEVELING Hunt For Netflix Might Be Shorter Than Expected
item.description: A new report suggests that Netflix’s upcoming live-action adaptation of Solo Leveling will launch with a compact seven-episode first season.
